x: Our young team of Debbie Hearn, Cathy Eastham and Tania Sturton made up the Belles 'A' trio. Most of our local rivals manage to turn out men's and women's teams at the same venues these days and making the effort of getting a team together is half the battle.
We were also one short in the senior women's team race where Helen Maskrey led home Syreeta Stracey and Cathy Eastham who were surprised to find that the distance was a full 8 kilometres.

Cathy Eastham did not relish 5 miles of 'Parly Hill' but did well to finish half-way down the senior field. Among the Senior Men Lee Hurst quite obviously did not enjoy the mud and at 66th was well down on his 12th of last winter.
Both Syreeta Stracey and Cathy Eastham have come on tremendously throughout the season there is no doubt that we now have a nucleus of runners who should be able to maintain a Division One place.

Proving that her run in the Yacht Handicap was no fluke, Syretta Stracey turned in another impressive performance and with Cathy Eastham, Nina Mills and Sam Symonds to close in the team we were only narrowly beaten by the Windmilers.

Cathy Eastham maintained the pressure by holding on to 8th and taking a minute off her previous best while Syretta Stracey moved the team up another two places with an outstanding 18:21 and then looked as if she could hardly believe her performance herself.

Another strong run came from Tania Sturton and with Syretta Stracey maintaining her 16th place, Cathy Eastham moving up two places and Sam Symonds no fewer that nine, a devastating blow was dealt to the other clubs in division two and – barring accidents – it is beginnning to look as if promotion beckons.
